description: Italy PEC Lookup - Certified Email & SDI Code by VAT. Resolve an Italian company's certified PEC email (domicilio digitale) and SDI e-invoicing code from a Partita IVA, Codice Fiscale or company name. For fatturazione elettronica, KYC and bulk enrichment. No official API. Advanced fields beyond this schema are also accepted (regdata_describe lists them).

identifiers.description: One or more Italian VAT numbers (Partita IVA), Codici Fiscali, or company names. One result row per identifier.
identifiers.title: Identifiers (P.IVA / CF / name)

maxItems.description: Optional cap on billed dataset items returned.

name: regdata_italy_pec
